name: Creality Sprite Pro
description: The Creality Sprite Pro is an all-metal direct drive extruder and hotend assembly designed as a factory upgrade for Creality printers such as the Ender 3 S1 Pro. It features dual drive gears, a 3.5:1 gear ratio, an all-metal hotend capable of printing high-temperature filaments, and an integrated stepper motor. It replaces the stock Bowden setup with a compact direct drive system.

physicalSpecs.mountPattern: Creality Sprite standard mount (Ender 3 S1 series)

features: All-metal hotend for high-temperature filament printing
Dual drive gears for improved filament grip
